function.name: read_file
function.description: Read the contents of a file. Optionally specify a 1-based line range. If append_loc is true, each line is prefixed with its line number (e.g. "1→ ...").

append_loc.description: Prefix each line with its line number

end_line.description: Last line to read, 1-based inclusive (default: end of file)

function.name: file_glob_search
function.description: Recursively search for files matching a glob pattern under a directory.

exclude.description: Glob pattern for files to exclude

include.description: Glob pattern for files to include (e.g. "**/*.cpp"). Default: **

function.name: grep_search
function.description: Search for a regex pattern in files under a path. Returns matching lines.

path.description: File or directory to search in

pattern.description: Regular expression pattern to search for

return_line_numbers.description: If true, include line numbers in results

function.name: exec_shell_command
function.description: Execute a shell command and return its output (stdout and stderr combined).

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file, creating it (including parent directories) if it does not exist. May use with edit_file for more complex edits.

path.description: Path of the file to write

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Edit a file by applying a list of line-based changes. Each change targets a 1-based inclusive line range and has a mode: "replace" (replace lines with content), "delete" (remove lines, content must be empty string), "append" (insert content after line_end). Set line_start to -1 to target the end of file (line_end is ignored in that case). Changes must not overlap. They are applied in reverse line order automatically.

content.description: Content to insert; must be empty string for delete mode

line_end.description: Last line of the range (1-based, inclusive); ignored when line_start is -1

line_start.description: First line of the range (1-based); use -1 for end of file

path.description: Path to the file to edit

function.name: apply_diff
function.description: Apply a unified diff to edit one or more files using git apply. Use this instead of edit_file when the changes are complex.

diff.description: Unified diff content in git diff format

function.name: get_datetime
function.description: Returns the current date and time

function.name: web_search
function.description: Perform an anonymous web search query through DuckDuckGo HTML using Tor and htmlq, returning a JSON array of search result objects containing title, url and snippet.

query.description: The search query terms to lock up (e.g. 'cachyos arch linux')

function.name: web_fetch
function.description: Fetch and extract the main content of a specific web page. Sanitizes it to high-fidelity Markdown, optimized for terminal reading and AI consumption. Supports JS-rendering fallback, proxying and content-filtering.

url.description: The target website URL to fetch.

use_javascript.description: If true, boot-up a headless browser to render SPAs / Dynamic content. If false (default), execute a lightweight raw HTML transfer using curl/fetch (much faster, saves battery & RAM).

proxy.description: Optional proxy URL (e.g. 'socks5h://127.0.0.1:9050' for Tor). If omitted, falls back to the system environment defaults.
